scenarios.name: STRUCTURING
scenarios.description: Transactions between 75-99% of reporting threshold indicating deliberate avoidance

scenarios.name: RAPID_MOVEMENT
scenarios.description: Funds received and sent out within 24 hours indicating pass-through layering

scenarios.name: HIGH_RISK_CORRIDOR
scenarios.description: Transaction involving FATF grey or black list jurisdiction
scenarios.regulatory_basis: FATF Grey List Feb 2026, RBI KYC Directions 2025

scenarios.name: FAN_IN
scenarios.description: Account receiving funds from unusually high number of distinct senders indicating mule activity

scenarios.name: ROUND_AMOUNT
scenarios.description: Suspiciously round transaction amount above reporting threshold indicating placement

scenarios.name: PEP_TRANSACTION
scenarios.description: Transaction involving a Politically Exposed Person requiring enhanced scrutiny
scenarios.regulatory_basis: PMLA 2002, RBI KYC Directions 2025, UK MLR 2017

scenarios.name: CASH_INTENSIVE
scenarios.description: High volume cash transactions inconsistent with customer profile

scenarios.name: VELOCITY_BREACH
scenarios.description: Transaction count or volume exceeds expected pattern in rolling 7-day window

scenarios.name: CRYPTO_HIGH_VALUE
scenarios.description: Cryptocurrency or virtual asset transaction above high-value threshold — high anonymity and cross-border layering risk requiring mandatory enhanced due diligence
scenarios.regulatory_basis: FATF Recommendation 15 (VASP), RBI Circular on Virtual Digital Assets 2022, PMLA 2002 Schedule

scenarios.name: HIGH_VALUE_WIRE
scenarios.description: Single cross-border wire transfer above high-value threshold — potential placement or layering vehicle
scenarios.regulatory_basis: PMLA 2002 Section 12, FATF Recommendation 16 (Wire Transfer Rule), RBI FEMA Reporting
